collection.title: Mitsubishi i 2006 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mitsubishi i 2006 to 2013 model requires a 28" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Mitsubishi i, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
